title: Design doc + spike for pluggable publishers (Markus static path)

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
As a Papyrus pod operator (Pilobil.us), I want to publish via a Markus static-Markdown front end alongside the existing Pretext site type, so that the same standard content model can be toggled to either publisher.

Scope: design doc under docs/ + minimal spike (publisher interface stub + config enum). No Pretext removal, no second content model. Branch from develop, PR into develop.
